messages:
marco: heads-up: int3 bring-up (qbringup) showing quality dip on codegen prompts. baseline vs int3 ~6-8% pass@1 drop on code evals. need curation + golden check to tell if model or quant tokenizer artifact.

olivia: can you share failing examples? long-context or short?

marco: mostly long (>=512 tokens) with mixed NL + code. dumped ~200 examples to /tmp/int3_code_deltas.jsonl; many truncation-like completions.

ben: ian sample stratified by language (py/js), length bucket, inline backticks. suggest 120 labels.

lina: propose updating golden selection: add "edge_coverage" tag for tokenizer_split_variance>0.12 or many punctuation tokens to surface tokenizer-sensitive prompts.

sara: agree. codify selection SQL and add dedupe fuzzy_jaccard<0.85.

olivia: add smoke harness to run baseline vs int3 on candidates and compute pass@1, exact_match, compile_check. sample command: ai-eval harness run --models baseline,int3 --input candidates.jsonl --metrics pass@1,exact_match,compile_ok --save-diffs out/diffs.jsonl

deploy-bot: canary deployed: qbringup/int3-smoke v0.3 -> infra-quant :rocket:

marco: plan: ben run labeling (120 + 40 control), olivia run harness + ablation (toggle kv_cache_alignment & attention_chunk), lina draft golden metadata change (tokenizer_sensitivity_delta low/med/high) + RFC, sara QA query and add dedupe. want initial results ~24h.

ben: kicked off job, added tag "int3-audit-apr2026", will update as labels arrive. rubric: PASS, FAIL-HALLU, FAIL-TRUNC, AMBIG.

olivia: will run ablations: for attention_chunk in [8,16] and kv_cache_alignment in [true,false] and compare diffs.

lina: if tokenizer-sensitive, propose short-term token remap pass in compile pipeline; will open RFC and link audit.

marco: thanks. we'll convene if regression persists; otherwise decide fallback to int4 vs kernel tweak.
